summary: IBC compliance; settlement after CIRP admission; US Delaware Court injunction involving USD 533m; contempt finding against Riju Raveendran; locus of financial creditor to challenge NCLAT settlement approval; inherent powers under NCLAT Rule 11; NCLAT's reapproval of settlement without addressing fund source concerns; dismissal of appeal to revive Section 7 petition; CIRP continuation sustained.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.7, s.9, s.14
National Company Law Appellate Tribunal Rules, 2016 Rule 11
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; NCLAT judgment upheld; CIRP continues; Section 7 petition revival denied.
